amendment_reason: Before any eligible prospective forecast was captured, live source inspection showed that a file downloaded on 2026-10-18 contained completed matches only through 2026-10-12, while saved fixture metadata included 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17 kickoffs. This is a source completeness safeguard, not an outcome/performance-driven threshold.

feature_source.as_of_join: Only completed source rows with match_date strictly before the quote's UTC calendar date may contribute to the original 19-feature builder.
feature_source.identity_alias_adapter: V2-local only; Atalanta BC -> Atalanta; global league aliases unchanged.

feature_input_gate.purpose: Permit archived current-season match data as lagged features for future quotes only.

source_schedule_completeness_gate.schedule_source: Existing saved Serie A odds_snapshots fixture metadata only
source_schedule_completeness_gate.deduplicate: Latest saved snapshot per event_id, then canonical fixture date/home/away identity.
source_schedule_completeness_gate.rule: For every fixture with latest saved kickoff on a calendar date strictly before the current-season source observation date, require the canonical (kickoff UTC date, home team, away team) identity in the completed current-season CSV. Any missing fixture or unavailable schedule metadata blocks all current-form forecasts until a new source archive passes.
source_schedule_completeness_gate.same_day_fixtures: Not used as features and excluded from schedule-gap blocking because the public source is date-only.
source_schedule_completeness_gate.failure_action: Block forecast admission; preserve source and gap report; do not infer postponements or outcomes.

quote_admission.quote_source: Existing saved SERIE_A 1X2 quote observations; this workflow never calls an odds provider.

target_outcome_evaluation_gate.purpose_after_gate: Diagnostic review only; never fit, select, tune thresholds, or automatically promote.
target_outcome_evaluation_gate.review_signal_requires: After 30 eligible forward forecasts have completed, residual shadow Brier AND LogLoss must each beat both de-vigged market and frozen incumbent. This signal cannot mutate the frozen candidate or active lambda.
